examined_formations.title: CURRENT_JIAXING_SINGLE_OFFICE_WITH_IMMEDIATE_POST_TRANSFER_RENT
examined_formations.chinese_title: 嘉兴名典公寓办510室二拍76.32万元 → 5000元/月 → 过户之日起即可收租 → 租至2029-05-15
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current Jiaxing Nanhu District People's Court second auction runs 2026-09-30 through 2026-10-01 for one 259.68 sqm office unit at RMB 763,200. The unit is leased through 2029-05-15 at RMB 5,000/month. The public court-sale republication says rent is currently collected monthly due to the judicial disposition and that the buyer may collect from the transfer date, including a pro-rata transfer-month amount. Nominal annual rent is RMB 60,000, about 7.86% of the current floor before all costs. Public facts also show seizure and mortgage, title documents not physically recovered but transfer stated unaffected, property-fee arrears stated at RMB 17,295 through 2026-12-31 and contractually borne by the tenant, while exact taxes, transfer timing, tenant identity, lease deposit, complete rent ledger, land-use termination date and physical condition remain open.

attraction_brief.a_side: A current second auction exposes one office unit at an exact RMB 763,200 floor.
attraction_brief.a_side_evidence: Auction date, exact unit, area and floor are public.
attraction_brief.b_side: An existing tenant pays RMB 5,000/month through 2029-05-15.
attraction_brief.b_side_evidence: Rent, term and buyer receipt right from transfer date are public.
attraction_brief.connection_wow: This is a fresh single-asset case with exact price, exact rent, explicit transfer-date buyer receipts and a 7.86% nominal gross ratio.

decisive_unknowns: Tenant identity and payment quality are not public.
Full lease, deposit quantum and complete rent ledger are not public.
Exact transfer date is unknown, so exact future receipt months must be confirmed against the >=24 month rule.
Exact buyer-side taxes and normalized net yield are not public.
Land-use termination date is listed as unknown and physical condition is not independently verified.

examined_formations.title: CURRENT_WEIYUAN_SINGLE_SHOP_WITH_HIGH_GROSS_RENT_AND_PREPAID_WINDOW
examined_formations.chinese_title: 威远严陵镇兰花街46号商业用房一拍44.588628万元 → 6000元/月 → 2026-11月底前已付 → 租至2029-02-24
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current Weiyuan County People's Court first auction runs 2026-10-18 through 2026-10-19 for one 45.08 sqm commercial unit at RMB 445,886.28. The notice explicitly says it is sold with the lease, current rent is RMB 6,000/month paid quarterly, lease ends 2029-02-24, and the tenant has paid through the end of 2026-11. Civil Code Article 725 states that an ownership change during the tenant's possession does not affect lease validity. Nominal annual rent is RMB 72,000, about 16.15% of the floor. From 2026-12-01 to lease end is about 26.8 months, so the >=24 month rule has only a narrow transfer-timing margin and must be confirmed before promotion. The exact lease, tenant identity, deposit, first buyer payment cycle, arrears, taxes and physical/title diligence remain open.

attraction_brief.a_side: A current first auction exposes one small commercial unit at an exact RMB 445,886.28 floor.
attraction_brief.a_side_evidence: Auction dates, single unit, area and floor are public.
attraction_brief.b_side: Existing tenant pays RMB 6,000/month under a lease through 2029-02-24.
attraction_brief.b_side_evidence: Rent, quarterly cadence, prepaid-through date and lease end are public.
attraction_brief.connection_wow: The 16.15% nominal gross ratio is materially stronger than recent retained scans, but durability depends on a narrow transfer-timing margin and exact rent succession.

decisive_unknowns: Exact auction-specific first buyer rent cycle after transfer is not public.
Tenant identity, complete lease, deposit and payment ledger are not public.
The future receipt duration has only about a 2.8-month cushion over the 24-month rule if receipts start 2026-12-01, so transfer delay is decisive.
Exact arrears, taxes, transfer costs and physical/title condition require case-specific diligence.

examined_formations.title: CURRENT_SHANGHAI_PUDONG_SMALL_UNIT_WITH_EXPLICIT_LEASE_SUCCESSION_BUT_ECONOMICS_FAIL
examined_formations.chinese_title: 上海浦东大道1700弄33号201室一拍151.52963万元 → 2000元/月 → 买受人承继租约 → 租至2029-04-30
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current Shenzhen Pingshan District People's Court first auction runs 2026-10-19 through 2026-10-20 for one 51.09 sqm Shanghai unit at RMB 1,515,296.30. The lease runs 2026-05-01 through 2029-04-30 at RMB 2,000/month, paid monthly. The notice explicitly states the buyer must succeed to the original owner's lease rights and obligations. Annual nominal rent is only RMB 24,000, about 1.58% of the floor before all costs, while property-management, utilities, repair-fund and transfer risks remain buyer diligence items. Economics hard-fail retention independently.
exact_disconfirmation: Nominal gross annual rent / floor is only about 1.58%.
Buyer also bears diligence/collection exposure for property management, utilities and related unsettled charges.
Strong legal continuity does not rescue obviously weak receipt-to-entry economics.

examined_formations.title: CURRENT_WUHAN_LONG_LEASE_COMMERCIAL_ASSET_WITH_EXPLICIT_SUCCESSION_BUT_LOW_YIELD_AND_LARGE_ENTRY
examined_formations.chinese_title: 武汉鹦鹉大道48号B座2层1号商网变卖997.6232万元 → 22/25元㎡月 → 买受人继受租约至2039
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current Wuhan Intermediate People's Court change sale runs 2026-10-04 through 2026-12-03 for one registered commercial asset of 1,367.52 sqm at RMB 9,976,232. The whole asset is leased to Wuhan Tianxia Mingqihui Commercial Operation Management Co., Ltd. through 2039-12-31. Rent is RMB 22/sqm/month through 2027-09-30 then RMB 25/sqm/month through 2039-09-30, and the notice says the buyer immediately succeeds to the lease. That equals about RMB 361,025/year at the current step, only about 3.62% of the floor, rising to about 4.11% at the next step before costs. The nearly RMB10m entry and sub-4.2% gross economics hard-fail this attraction lane.
exact_disconfirmation: Current-step annual rent is about RMB 361,025, only about 3.62% of the nearly RMB10m floor.
Next-step annual rent is about RMB 410,256, only about 4.11% gross before taxes, arrears and ownership costs.
The large entry price and weak gross ratio are independently inconsistent with the current low-friction attraction lane.

excluded_observations.reason: Auction buyer pays rent to obtain a leasehold; money flows out from the buyer rather than producing inherited buyer receipts, so wrong-flow formations are excluded before deep diligence.
Exact current rent can exist, but mixed-use/multi-title bundles or pooled receipts fail the single/economically-separable asset gate before deeper diligence.

commercial_outcome.summary: Scan 136 found two fresh single-asset research survivors without commercial promotion. Jiaxing binds an exact RMB763,200 floor, RMB5,000/month rent, lease to 2029-05-15 and explicit rent collection from transfer at about 7.86% nominal gross. Weiyuan binds an exact RMB445,886.28 floor, RMB6,000/month rent, prepaid through 2026-11 and lease to 2029-02-24 at about 16.15% nominal gross, but its exact buyer receipt start and narrow >24-month transfer margin remain open. Shanghai and Wuhan are authoritatively demoted on gross economics.
